description.value:
Frequency once per day

Check Occultism or Society (your choice)

Reach out through the network. Attempt a check against a DC the GM sets by the obscurity of what you are asking. On a success you learn what the network knows about one person, place, or event; on a critical success, you also learn who else has been asking. On a failure you learn nothing. On a critical failure you learn something false and the network learns you were asking. You always know whether a settlement you are in has anyone on the network at all.
